subject: control_systems

resources.title: Python Control Systems Library Documentation
resources.notes: Reference implementation and examples for classical/state-space control analysis.

resources.title: Introduction to Electrical Engineering and Computer Science I - Control Systems Units
resources.notes: Introductory systems material includes designing control systems and state-machine/system concepts, providing a legitimate lower-level bridge into feedback and dynamic systems.

resources.title: Analysis and Design of Feedback Control Systems
resources.notes: Undergraduate feedback-control course supporting analysis and design of dynamic feedback systems.

resources.title: Dynamic Systems and Control
resources.notes: Graduate treatment of dynamic systems, feedback interconnections, stability and performance with an open textbook and assessment materials.

resources.title: Multivariable Control Systems
resources.notes: Advanced multivariable and robust control reference; not mapped downward to beginner levels.

resources.title: Analysis and Design of Digital Control Systems
resources.notes: Dedicated digital-control depth for sampled-data and computer-controlled systems.

resources.title: Modelica Association Resources
resources.notes: Equation-based physical-system modeling reference used for dynamic simulation and control studies.

resources.title: Cyber-Physical Systems Resources
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.notes: Authoritative systems-engineering and cyber-physical research reference.

resources.title: NASA Technical Reports Server - Guidance, Navigation and Control
resources.notes: Research literature path for aerospace guidance, navigation and control; verify each report before ingestion.

known_gaps: Beginner coverage for robust, adaptive, nonlinear, optimal and model-predictive control remains intentionally limited rather than mapping graduate material downward.
Model-predictive control needs a dedicated verified instructional source beyond general physical-modeling resources.
Expert readiness still requires runtime retrieval, simulation projects, verification and validation, provenance, and assessment.
